app.name: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition
app.coder: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition contributors
app.long_description: v0.3 movement playground with placeholder graphics. Move with the Nunchuk, Classic or GameCube stick or D-pad. Hold A to jump higher; jump again soon after landing for double and triple jumps. Spin with Remote B or Nunchuk C, Classic X or GameCube B. Ground pound with Nunchuk Z, Classic ZR or GameCube Z. Pause with PLUS, HOME or GameCube START; select Exit to Loader to quit. Story Mode is not implemented.
